# Orientation regression fixtures

`portrait-orientation.heic` and `portrait-orientation.avif` are synthetic images generated by `cargo run --example generate_orientation_fixtures` (requires local HEVC and AV1 encoders). They contain an 80 × 48 four-color pattern, a clockwise 90° container rotation, and a matching EXIF orientation of 6. Their displayed size is 48 × 80, with blue/red above yellow/green. Tests use the committed fixtures so only decoders are needed.

`representative.heic` is the existing libheif-rs fixture described in the project README.
